# Versions in strictly ascending precedence order, one per line.
#
# Both comparators assert against this file: tests/unit/test_version.cpp for the
# ordering the in-app updater uses, and tests/shell/test_version_compare.bats for
# the copy CI runs before it moves a channel manifest forward. A line added here
# fails both suites until both implementations agree, which is the point: the rule
# has to live in two languages, so it gets one set of cases.
#
# Blank lines and #-comments are skipped. Build metadata (+sha) does not affect
# precedence, so it never appears here; those equality cases live in the tests.
#
# The ladder from 1.1.0-alpha through 1.1.0 is the worked example in Semantic
# Versioning 2.0.0 section 11, kept verbatim so a reader can check it against the
# spec rather than against our reasoning.

0.99.118
1.0.0
1.0.1
1.0.2
1.0.99
1.1.0-1
1.1.0-11
1.1.0-alpha
1.1.0-alpha.1
1.1.0-alpha.beta
1.1.0-beta
1.1.0-beta.2
1.1.0-beta.11
1.1.0-rc.1
1.1.0
1.1.1
1.2.0-beta.1
1.2.0
2.0.0
